request.query: dependent choice sequence satisfying a serial relation and prescribed initial element

items.name: RelSeries
items.type: {α : Type u_1} → SetRel α α → Type u_1

items.name: RelSeries.head
items.type: {α : Type u_1} → {r : SetRel α α} → RelSeries r → α

items.name: Set.seq_of_forall_finite_exists
items.type:
∀ {γ : Type u_1} {P : γ → Set γ → Prop},
  (∀ (t : Set γ), t.Finite → ∃ c, P c t) → ∃ u, ∀ (n : ℕ), P (u n) (u '' Set.Iio n)

items.name: RelSeries.rec
items.type:
{α : Type u_1} →
  {r : SetRel α α} →
    {motive : RelSeries r → Sort u} →
      ((length : ℕ) →
          (toFun : Fin (length + 1) → α) →
            (step : ∀ (i : Fin length), (toFun i.castSucc, toFun i.succ) ∈ r) →
              motive { length := length, toFun := toFun, step := step }) →
        (t : RelSeries r) → motive t

items.name: RelSeries.recOn
items.type:
{α : Type u_1} →
  {r : SetRel α α} →
    {motive : RelSeries r → Sort u} →
      (t : RelSeries r) →
        ((length : ℕ) →
            (toFun : Fin (length + 1) → α) →
              (step : ∀ (i : Fin length), (toFun i.castSucc, toFun i.succ) ∈ r) →
                motive { length := length, toFun := toFun, step := step }) →
          motive t

items.name: exists_seq_of_forall_finset_exists'
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_4} (P : α → Prop) (r : α → α → Prop) [Std.Symm r],
  (∀ (s : Finset α), (∀ x ∈ s, P x) → ∃ y, P y ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, r x y) →
    ∃ f, (∀ (n : ℕ), P (f n)) ∧ Pairwise (Function.onFun r f)
